The C-only model (which sees only the context, not the question) scores very low on MuSiQue-Ans. The numbers depend on the split:

| Split | Answer F1 (An) | Support F1 (Sp) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Validation | 3.4 | 0.0 | Table 4, p. 11 |
| Test | 3.7 | 0.0 | Table 5, p. 11 |

The paper says Table 5 reports test-set numbers and all other results are on the validation set (p. 10). The validation figures (3.4 | 0.0) appear again in Tables 6 (p. 11) and 7 (p. 12) as the reference row.

**Context:**
- **Comparison with other datasets:** On HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA, the C-only model identifies supporting paragraphs well (67.6 and 92.0 Sp). It "fails on MuSiQue-Ans" (p. 11).
- **Why the support score is low:** The authors attribute this to using "positive distractors" rather than full Wikipedia. With full-Wikipedia distractors, the C-only support score on MuSiQue-Ans would have been 66.4 Sp (p. 12).
- **MuSiQue-Full:** On the harder variant, the C-only model scores 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf (Table 5, p. 11).
